label: P01-F
title: Караульная · персонажи фронтально
prompt:
Create one coarse pixel-art dungeon battle scene. First attached dungeon image is STYLE ONLY: copy muted gray-green stone, dusty brown/mauve walls, purple-black void, restrained cyan/ochre accents, compact large-headed sprites, coarse clusters and sparse detail. DO NOT copy its top-down camera. The tile geometry reference defines our ISOMETRIC floor: symmetric diamond tile tops with width:height EXACTLY 4:3, not thin 2:1 diamonds. Floor directions slope down-right and down-left; every seam follows those two axes. Low walls follow the isometric grid. Show the whole small room with margin, no text or panels. STRICT PLACEMENT: six small combatants, three adventurers and three monsters, each alone on one clearly visible floor tile. Midpoint between both soles at the center of that tile; both feet inside that diamond, never on a seam. Characters short enough to leave floor visible around feet. Boots touch the floor directly: NO pedestals, bases, discs, plinths, circular platforms, rings or selection circles. Only a tiny contact shadow, no broad oval shadow resembling a base. Separate readable shield, bow, dagger, caster and monster silhouettes. Crisp stepped pixels, simple shading, no smoothing or noisy texture. 4:3 image format.
CHARACTERS: flat front-facing 2D sprites like the style reference, with horizontal shoulders and face/chest looking toward the viewer; do NOT rotate their bodies to isometric. The ROOM AND FLOOR remain fully isometric. Both feet still touch the center of one diamond tile.
ROOM: Square guard chamber: rear entrance arch, low broken pillar in one central tile, two clay jars against the back wall, crates at the far corner; broad quiet walking space.
